steps.description: Implement the numerical experiment to probe solution space rigidity via small MLPs. Construct a simple linear constraint family (rigid case) where the solution is a unique function, then train MLPs with varying hidden widths using scipy.optimize.minimize(method='L-BFGS-B') to find the minimum width N_c(w) achieving zero violation (max absolute error ≤ 1e-3) on held-out constraints. Use multiple random seeds and report the trend of N_c(w) versus constraint count w.
